mapper.insert: insert into crowd_tags_detail(tag_id, user_id, create_time, update_time) values (#{tagId}, #{userId}, now(), now())
mapper.select: select id, tag_id, user_id, create_time, update_time from crowd_tags_detail where tag_id = #{tagId} order by id desc
select id, tag_id, user_id, create_time, update_time from crowd_tags_detail where user_id = #{userId} order by id desc
mapper.delete: delete from crowd_tags_detail where tag_id = #{tagId} and user_id = #{userId}
